source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 iunie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Eusebiu, Episcopul Samosatelor»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ευσέβιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries. The day's line gives only «Άγιος Ευσέβιος», but the page names him bishop of Samosata, so against the corpus's eight other men of the name it is this one: exiled under Valens to a desert place by the river Ister and killed by a stone thrown at his head by a heretic woman. The page's heading reads «(; - 380)» and its narrative puts the blow in «το έτος 380 μ.Χ.», a year the folder carries no `dates` for; the year is reported rather than written, because the folder's own source gives none. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge Sfinţite Mucenice Eusebiu, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Eusebiu, Episcopul Samosatelor, glasul 4; the text is the common of a hieromartyr, printed with his name in it.

english.text: Having become a sharer of the apostles' ways and a successor to their thrones, thou didst find in action, O God-inspired one, an ascent to contemplation. Therefore, rightly dividing the word of truth, and contending for the faith even unto blood, O Hieromartyr Eusebius, intercede with Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Σοφίας τοῦ Πνεύματος, καταυγασθεῖς τῷ φωτί, τὸν λόγον ἐτράνωσας, τῆς εὐσέβειας ἠμίν, Εὐσέβιε ἔνδοξε, σὺ γὰρ ἱεραρχήσας, εὐσεβῶς τὴ Τριάδι, ἤθλησας θεοφρόνως, καὶ τὴν πλάνην καθεῖλες. Καὶ νῦν Πάτερ δυσώπησον, σώζεσθαι ἅπαντας.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Ευσέβιος», and it names him; the second is the common of a hierarch, «Κανόνα πίστεως», and is not taken

english.text: Lit up by the light of the Spirit's wisdom, you made plain to us the word of piety, O glorious Eusebius; for having served as a hierarch piously before the Trinity, you contended with a godly mind and brought down error. And now, father, entreat that all may be saved.
